definitions.explanation: Two times the amount or number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二倍|にばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{二倍|にばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二倍|にばい}⟦{売|う}れた→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: This year sold twice as much as last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二倍|にばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The population doubled, so new schools are needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{二倍|にばい}⟦{速|はや}くて→速い：00514_hayai⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戻|もど}れない→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The new computer is twice as fast as the old one, making work easier, so I can't go back to the old one anymore.

notes:
{二倍|にばい} means double or twice the amount.

PATTERN FOR MULTIPLES:
{数字|すうじ} + {倍|ばい} creates multipliers:
- {二倍|にばい}: double, twice
- {三倍|さんばい}: triple, three times
- {四倍|よんばい}: quadruple
- {十倍|じゅうばい}: tenfold
- {百倍|ひゃくばい}: hundredfold

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Aの{二倍|にばい}: twice as much as A
- {二倍|にばい}になる: to double (intransitive)
- {二倍|にばい}にする: to double (transitive)
- {二倍|にばい}の{値段|ねだん}: double the price

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {二倍|にばい}: double (exact multiple)
- {二重|にじゅう}: double, twofold (layers/structure)
- {倍増|ばいぞう}: doubling (formal term for increases)
